body:
Reported on 1.14.0. Shopping and checklist lists put a full-width Add button at the
top; the expense list uses a floating action button at the bottom right. The user
wants the lists to look roughly alike, with the floating button everywhere, "since
that's the default these days", and the expense list to use the common colour style.

Scope as read:
- ListScreen: the top Add button becomes a bottom-right floating button, in the
  same colours as the button it replaces; the last row must stay reachable above it.
- ExpenseListScreen: the same floating button, and the look of the other lists —
  date headings styled like category headings (the spec already says "sectioned by
  date", which the web does and Android did not), and item dividers like theirs.
Web is not in scope: both web list screens already put Add at the top.
title: android: one layout for all list kinds — Add as a bottom-right button, the expense list in the common style
